name: Opyn ETH put double exercise
summary: oToken.exercise(amount, vaults) looped over the given vaults and checked the unchanged msg.value against each vault's ETH due, so one ETH payment exercised several vaults. Attackers exercised their own vault together with a victim's, received both vaults' USDC collateral, and took the single ETH payment back from their own vault with removeUnderlying().
notes: Campaign: every tx with two or more Exercise events on one ETH-underlying oToken from factory 0xcc5d905b, across all 33 such series since launch; none precede the anchor. Three senders hit the 80 Sep, 00 Aug and 30 Aug puts within six hours.

Loss is the amtCollateralToPay of the victim vaults (every exercised vault other than the attacker's own), priced per tx by DefiLlama; it matches Opyn's 371,260 USDC. Surplus collateral the attackers left in their own vaults is not netted, and the unbacked ETH credited to victims does not offset.
